title: It was good. I went out to her garden.
scene: 回家被问今天怎么样，讲奶奶的菜园。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: How was your visit to Grandma's house today?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It was good. I went out to her garden.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did you see out there?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It was completely full of tomatoes.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did you pick any of them?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I picked one big red one, and I went to show it to Grandma.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: She must have really liked that.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She told me it was her favorite kind of tomato.
